name: VolunteerProjectPage - Full Project
description: A volunteer project's detail page with every field an organizer can fill: the uncropped photo, the time commitment, the blurb as a lede, the full markdown description, and the project's own sign-up button. The markdown body is the part that mattered — before this page existed nothing on the site rendered a project's body at all, so a description written in the CMS was invisible to visitors.
